fullResponse:
Starting the review-03 validation: reading the brief, scope and the since-review-01 patch first.

Confirmed one item already: the founding lobby sky keeps brightness 120 while the sky surface now scales albedo by brightness. Collecting the final server-side, client and evidence details now.

Found a leftover reference to the removed per-chunk path in the Erlang GUI example test helper. One last read to confirm its effect, then the report.

No further reads are needed. Final report for review-03 follows.

All references are to the frozen tree at `_build/terrain-presentation-20261017/review-03/tree/`, which matched the working tree for client, priv, src, test, include, doc and native at inspection time. Inspection was read-only: file reads, greps, one tree diff and a JSON summary of evidence files. No build, test, edit, memory update or delegation. The stop notifier was not invoked. Frozen01 was not re-reviewed and review-02 was not reviewed separately.

## Verdict

The bounded-content refactor and the four frozen01 corrections are sound in design and in the production code I read. The single-credit invariant the brief asks me to verify holds: the owner sends a pose or a resource only when credit is held, and a resource holds that credit until its own exact acknowledgement, so no frame can arrive during a client checksum or render await. Two confirmed issues block treating this freeze as gate-ready: a test helper still speaks the removed wire path and will fail the world library case, and the lobby sky's founding brightness was not re-authored for the new once-applied semantics, which darkens every lobby panorama on client deployment alone. Both are small, exact fixes. Everything else is risk, not defect.

**Verified sound.** On the server, `src/quod_physics.erl:884-895` tries a fresh pose first only when the previous delivery was a resource, then delivers resources with credit intact, so resources and poses alternate and neither starves. Acknowledgements are fenced by delivery kind and token at lines 174-191: a frame ack needs `delivery := frame` with matching tick and origin sequence, a want ack needs the outstanding manifest token, and a complete ack needs the outstanding content token. Any other ack leaves the viewer unchanged. The content message at lines 931-937 carries exactly the wanted indices in snapshot order, and an empty wanted set still produces a content message. The outgoing frame is not subject to the incoming `max_frame_size` at `src/quod_client_view.erl:44`. On the client, `client/src/simulation.js:223-259` releases credit without installing when interest moved, requires the content set to equal the missing set in order, verifies every digest and header before installing anything, installs atomically, and marks readiness only when the interest is still current. Because a resource holds credit until that final ack, the object-identity liveness at line 169 remains safe under this design; the delayed-render case at `client/test/terrain-delivery.test.js:63-72` and the moving owner case at `test/quod_physics_tests.erl:5199-5212` pin the distinction. Renewal continuity at `simulation.js:156-171` requires an active, unexpired predecessor with identical fence and identical terrain marks including allowances, and the new registration still waits for its own manifest. Sky ordering at `client/src/scene.js:113-116` with `client/src/world-scene.js:44` places declared skies first in the opaque queue and falls back to Babylon's painter order. The sky surface at `client/src/render-resources.js:325` scales linear albedo once with no emissive. The shared command readiness predicate at `client/src/controlled-navigation.js:27` gates drive, jump, snap and teleport, and snap and teleport no longer reset held input unless they will send. Docs match code.

## Confirmed issues

- **The GUI example test helper still expects the removed wire path.** `test/quod_gui_examples_tests.erl:189-197` matches only `terrain_chunk` and `terrain_complete` after acknowledging the manifest. The owner now sends `terrain_chunks`, which matches no clause, so the helper waits out its deadline and raises `world_terrain_delivery_missing` at line 205. The world library case calls it at lines 119, 124 and 126. This file is in scope and the reviewed evidence for this freeze did not rerun that module. The full gate will fail on it. The fix is to accept the content message and acknowledge completion.
- **Lobby sky founding brightness was not re-authored.** `priv/ontologies/quod_lobby.pl:54` still founds `personal_sky` with brightness 120, the fixture at `test/quod_lobby_tests.erl:1490` agrees, and the new sky surface multiplies linear albedo by that factor. Every lobby panorama renders at twelve percent of the texture, where it previously rendered at roughly full strength plus a small emissive term. Already founded lobbies carry 120 in their own state, so the client deployment alone produces the darkening, and the brief confirms a binary deployment does not rewrite founded ontologies. The founding term needs the same scale as `priv/ontologies/lobby_worlds.pl:100`, and the separately prepared owner-signed appearance edit must cover existing lobbies.

## Risks

- **One large install instead of many small ones.** The whole missing set is verified, then installed in one render at `simulation.js:252-254`, and the shared credit withholds poses during that render. For a first window of a couple of hundred chunks this is one main-thread hitch and one message of up to the authored transfer allowance plus base64 overhead. Likely acceptable, but it belongs in the post-deployment timing gate the brief already names.
- **Fog and dome diverge away from full brightness.** `world-scene.js:116` scales the tint in gamma space while the dome scales linear albedo. They match only at brightness 1000. An edited brightness will show a horizon seam.
- **Doc precision.** `doc/voxel-world.md:337-338` says preparing a manifest does not withhold motion updates. An outstanding manifest still holds the credit until its want acknowledgement. Alternation is between acknowledged deliveries, as `doc/physics-native.md:815-817` states more carefully.
- **Carried from frozen01, unchanged by this scope.** The coast under the last accepted drive lease is retained by explicit decision. `world_palette/1` depends on `material_eidolons/2` in the live quod:lobby, and older personal lobbies may lack `environment_eidolons/2`, in which case `priv/ontologies/space_view.pl:35-36` shows a status label instead of a sky. `scene.js:106` recomputes the parent world matrix per camera render when the dome is parented.

## Evidence limits

No browser run has exercised the bounded content path, a new textured world or a sky; the brief says a visual preview is in preparation. The passing evidence for this freeze is the five owner and socket cases in `physics-bundle-focused-01` and the five client files in `client-review-focused-01`. The Erlang GUI example module was last run before the refactor. I did not recompute the source manifest hashes. The frozen tree still carries the large uncommitted predecessor delta against HEAD noted in frozen01. The preserving rollout and the owner-signed appearance edit are not reviewed here. This review is consultative, not deployment approval.
